entries.text: Once when she was a girl, a very little girl, Dana was in the woods. It was autumn. She had always been a tomboy, unlike her sister, Melissa. For her birthday, Dana's brothers had given her a bb gun... And were showing her how to use it. The father had told them only to shoot at cans. But in a patch of grass, bill jr. Found a garter snake. And the boys began shooting. Wanting to fit in with her brothers, Dana also shot at the snake. It squirmed wildly, desperately fighting for life, but as the boys continued to shoot, the snake began to bleed. When she realized what she had done, Dana began to cry with irrevocable guilt. Through her tears she was saying that... Something was missing from the snake. She had taken something that was not hers to take. And although deathly afraid of snakes, Dana held the animal as if... Sheer human will could keep it alive. The snake, its blood on her hands, died. There was nothing she could do to bring it back.

entries.text: Presently we have Dana listed in critical condition. Comatose. There is complete unawareness of self or environment. There is no evidence of language comprehension. No evidence of voluntary responses to external stimuli. My apologies, but, uh, no one here... Can determine how Dana arrived at the hospital, administered or how she was attended to in such a critical condition. Um, because of the absence of Dana's recent medical history, I'm at a loss for prognosis. I can't determine, with certainty, how long she's been in this state.

entries.text: You ignore my call for help and then you expect me to do what you say ? You go to hell !

entries.text: You got him killed ! You got her killed. That's not going to happen to me. You're my tool. You understand ? I come to you when I need you. Right now you're heading in a direction that can lead them right here.

entries.text: I used to be you. I was where you are now, but you're not me, Mulder. I don't think you have the heart. Walk away. Grieve for Scully... And then never look back. You will be able to live with yourself, Mulder, on the day you die.

entries.text: Federal agent ! Federal agent. You know I'm armed. Don't turn around. Put your gun very slowly on the ground. Put your hands behind your head. Interlock your fingers. entries.text: Discontinuing the respirator does not necessarily mean... Pulling the plug and ending her life. Karen ann quinlan lived for nine years... After cessation of mechanical ventilation. I do believe, however, that this is not the case with your daughter, mrs. Scully. My guess is that she's been in this state since her disappearance, and she will not improve.

entries.text: You've never provided an answer as to why she's here or what's wrong with her. We need to study her.

entries.text: She's not a piece of evidence.

entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: She's dying. That's perfectly natural. We hide people in these rooms because we don't want to look at death. We have machines prolong a life that should end. That's a much more unnatural circumstance than any cause of her death.

entries.text: That is very politically correct.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: That's very human. I love her. And this is right.

entries.text: Dana has made our decision. Fox ? You and Dana had a friendship built on respect. Now in the last year, I have lost my husband, and god knows, I don't want to lose my baby girl. entries.text: And then what ? He sleeps with the fishes ? We're not the mafia, Mulder. I know it's easy to forget, but we work for the department of justice.

entries.text: Agent Scully was a fine officer. More than that, I liked her. I respected her. We all know the field we play in and we all know what can happen in the course of a game. If you were unprepared for all the potentials, then you shouldn't step on the field.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner
entries.location: ASSISTANT DIRECTOR SKINNER'S OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: What if I-- I knew the potential consequences, but I-- I never told her ?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: ASSISTANT DIRECTOR SKINNER'S OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: Then you're as much to blame for her condition as... The cancer man.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner
entries.location: ASSISTANT DIRECTOR SKINNER'S OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: Hello, starbuck. It's ahab. People would say to me, "life is short. Kids, they grow up fast. Before you know it, it's over." I never listened. To me, life went at a proper pace. There were many rewards... Until the moment that... I knew, I understood that... I would never see you again. My little girl. Then my life felt as if it had been the length of one breath, one heartbeat. I never knew how much I loved my daughter... Until I could never tell her. At that moment, I would have traded every medal, every commendation, every promotion... For just one more second with you. We'll be together again, starbuck. But not now. Soon.
entries.speaker: William Scully
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: [ beeping continues ] Dana ? I know death is at arms reach tonight. But Dana, your time is not over.
entries.speaker: Nurse Owens
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: You know, Fox-- sorry. Mulder. You could spend the rest of your life finding every person who's responsible, and it's still not gonna bring her back. Whoever did this to her has an equal horror coming to them.
entries.speaker: Melissa Scully
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: Including myself ?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: [ woman ] pardon me. Sir, do you have change for the cigarette machine ?
entries.speaker: Woman
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: No. Sorry, I don't.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: What do you mean, yourself ?
entries.speaker: Melissa Scully
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: There's a pack already here. Morleys. Not my brand.
entries.speaker: Woman
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: [ woman on p.a., indistinct ]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: [ yelling ]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: Cigarette break ? How 'bout a smoke ?
entries.speaker: Man On Tv
entries.location: THE CIGARETTE-SMOKING MAN'S APARTMENT

entries.text: [ door opening ]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: Scene 01

entries.text: Sit down !
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: THE CIGARETTE-SMOKING MAN'S APARTMENT

entries.text: How'd you find me ?
entries.speaker: Cigarette-Smoking Man
entries.location: THE CIGARETTE-SMOKING MAN'S APARTMENT

entries.text: Shut up ! Tonight I ask the questions, and you're gonna answer me, you son of a bitch !
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: THE CIGARETTE-SMOKING MAN'S APARTMENT

entries.text: Don't try and threaten me, Mulder. I've watched presidents die.
entries.speaker: Cigarette-Smoking Man
entries.location: THE CIGARETTE-SMOKING MAN'S APARTMENT

entries.text: Why her ? Why her and not me ? Answer me !
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: THE CIGARETTE-SMOKING MAN'S APARTMENT

entries.text: I like you. I like her too. That's why she was returned to you.
entries.speaker: Cigarette-Smoking Man
entries.location: THE CIGARETTE-SMOKING MAN'S APARTMENT

entries.text: You should be the one to die.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: THE CIGARETTE-SMOKING MAN'S APARTMENT

entries.text: Why ? Look at me. No wife. No family. Some power. I'm in the game because I believe what I'm doing is right.
entries.speaker: Cigarette-Smoking Man
entries.location: THE CIGARETTE-SMOKING MAN'S APARTMENT

entries.text: Right ? Who are you to decide what's right ?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: THE CIGARETTE-SMOKING MAN'S APARTMENT

entries.text: Who are you ? If people were to know of the things that I know, it would all fall apart. I told Skinner you shot the man in the hospital, but I didn't really believe it. And here you are with a gun to my head. I have more respect for you, Mulder. You're becoming a player. You can kill me now, but you'll never know the truth. And that's why I'll win. Don't worry. This'll be our secret. We wouldn't want others to... Start rumors.
entries.speaker: Cigarette-Smoking Man
entries.location: THE CIGARETTE-SMOKING MAN'S APARTMENT

entries.text: When I started out, this room was where they kept the copier.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON D.C.

entries.text: At least back then it wasn't just wasted space.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON D.C.

entries.text: It's unacceptable. Look, I know you feel responsible for agent Scully, but I will not accept resignation and defeat as self-punishment.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON D.C.

entries.text: All the forensics, the field investigations, the eyewitness accounts, to still know nothing. To lose myself... And Scully. I hate what I've become.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON D.C.

entries.text: When I was 18, I, uh, I went to vietnam. I wasn't drafted, Mulder. I enlisted in the marine corps the day of my 18th birthday. I did it on a blind faith. I did it because I believed that it was the right thing to do. I don't know. Maybe I still do. Three months into my tour, a ten-year-old north vietnamese boy walked into camp covered with grenades. And I, uh, I blew his head off... From a distance of ten yards. I lost my faith. Not in my country or in myself, but in everything. There was just no point to anything anymore. One night on patrol, we were, uh, caught. And everyone-- everyone fell. Everyone. I looked down at my body... From outside of it. I didn't recognize it at first. I watched the v.c. Strip my uniform, take my weapon. And I remained... In this thick jungle. Peaceful. Unafraid. Watching my dead friends. Watching myself. In the morning, the corpsmen arrived and put me in a body bag until-- I guess they found a pulse. I don't know. I woke in a saigon hospital two weeks later. I'm afraid to look any further beyond that experience. You ? You are not. Your resignation is unacceptable.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON D.C.

entries.text: You. You gave me cancer man's location. You put your life in danger.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON D.C.

entries.text: Agent Mulder, every life, every day... Is in danger. That's just life.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON D.C.

entries.text: Your plane ticket.
entries.speaker: X
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON D.C.

entries.text: But we barely know each other.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON D.C.

entries.text: I can't tell you why she was taken. It's too close to me. I'm giving you the men who took her.
entries.speaker: X
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON D.C.

entries.text: How ?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON D.C.

entries.text: They believe you'll be out of town. They believe you have information about Scully... Being kept in your desk in your apartment. At 8:17 tonight, they'll search your apartment. They will be armed. You will be waiting.
entries.speaker: X
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON D.C.

entries.text: Waiting ?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON D.C.

entries.text: To defend yourself with terminal intensity. It's the only way, Mulder. The law will not punish these people. After tonight, we cannot make contact for several weeks.
entries.speaker: X
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON D.C.

entries.text: [ knock on door ]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: Scene 01

entries.text: Mulder. Sorry. I came by. You weren't answering. Your machine wasn't on. Can I come in ? For a second ? Why is it so dark in here ?
entries.speaker: Melissa Scully
entries.location: MULDER'S APARTMENT

entries.text: 'cause the lights aren't on.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: MULDER'S APARTMENT

entries.text: Okay. I just came from the hospital. Dr. Daly says... She's weakening. It could be any time, so I figured you'd want to come down and see her. Well, I can't. Well, I'd think that you would.
entries.speaker: Melissa Scully
entries.location: MULDER'S APARTMENT

entries.text: Yeah, I would. I can't. Not right now.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: MULDER'S APARTMENT

entries.text: Listen. I don't have to be psychic to see that you're in a very dark place, much darker than where my sister is. Willingly walking deeper into darkness cannot help her at all. Only the light will--
entries.speaker: Melissa Scully
entries.location: MULDER'S APARTMENT

entries.text: Oh, enough with the harmonic convergence crap. You're not saying anything to me.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: MULDER'S APARTMENT

entries.text: Why don't you just drop your cynicism and your paranoia and your defeat ? You know, just because it's positive and good doesn't make it silly or trite. Why-- why is it so much easier for you to run around... Trying to get even than just expressing to her how you feel ? Even if it doesn't bring her back, at least she'll know, and so will you.
entries.speaker: Melissa Scully
entries.location: MULDER'S APARTMENT

entries.text: I.c.u. Yes, that was two units.
entries.speaker: Hospital Staff
entries.location: MULDER'S APARTMENT

entries.text: Thank you.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: MULDER'S APARTMENT

entries.text: I feel, Scully, that... You believe you're not ready to go. And you've always had the strength of your beliefs. I don't know if my being here... Will help bring you back. But I'm here.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: [ door opening ]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: Scene 01

entries.text: [ sobbing ]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: Scene 01

entries.text: I'm afraid in this case--
entries.speaker: Hospital Staff
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: Let me check the chart.
entries.speaker: Hospital Staff
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: [ chattering ]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: Call dr. Daly. Now.
entries.speaker: Nurse
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: [ phone ringing ]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: [ answering machine ] hello, this is Fox Mulder. Leave a message please.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder (recorded)
entries.location: MULDER'S APARTMENT

entries.text: I'm here.
entries.speaker: Nurse
entries.location: MULDER'S APARTMENT

entries.text: Hello, Fox.
entries.speaker: Margaret Scully
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: Not Fox. Mulder.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: How ya feelin' ?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: I really don't remember anything... After Duane Barry.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: Doesn't-- doesn't matter. I brought you a present. The super stars of the super bowls.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: I knew there was a reason to live.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: Now you want to get some rest. I-- I just came by to see how you're doing and say hi.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: Mulder ? I had the strength of your beliefs.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: I was holding this for you.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: Can I see nurse owens ? I've got something I'd like her to have.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: Nurse who ?
entries.speaker: Nurse
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: Owens. Short with straight, light brown hair. She watched over me in intensive care, and I'd like to thank her.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: Dana, I've worked here for ten years, and there's no nurse owens at this hospital.
entries.speaker: Nurse
entries.location: NORTHEAST GEORGETOWN MEDICAL CENTER ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.
